notes: BIG: preview now matches the final render exactly. Caption layout (which words go in each caption + line breaks + timing) is computed by ONE engine on the server (build_timeline) and the preview just draws it — no more drift between the on-screen preview and the burned render. Styling (colours, stroke, shadow, scrim, karaoke, animation) stays instant client-side; layout refreshes on a short debounce like the exact preview, with a local fallback for the demo/pre-transcription placeholder. Also in this build: default presets baked into the app (whole team always has the library); the beta Animation can't hide captions; the last caption no longer hangs to the clip end on the board/merged path; Export names captioned files with the _nSub suffix removed; Export/Import a style as .json to share; green Export button. Fix: applying a preset now actually switches the font everywhere — the dropdown, the live preview and the render all follow the preset's font (before, a stale font could override it, so a preset showed one font but rendered another). Fix: editing captions in the Words tab now flows to the Text tab, the preview and the export — both tabs and the render share one word source, so your Words-tab edits are always burned in. Fix: Enter caption breaks are no longer lost on the way to the render — every path that prepares words (Assemble, board, hook save, LOC, export) now reads the breaks straight from your text like the preview does, instead of only inheriting older ones.
